objective: Independently inspect every planned master against its exact teaching claims and relational composition before any crop is authorized.
review_rules: Use view_image at original detail for every generated master and any canonical reference needed for comparison.
For reuse portraits, verify the path and hash match the approved manifest entry.
For every scene, verify exact participants, count, identity continuity, support, anatomy, phone count, screen identity, and forbidden extras.

For every device conversation, verify characters talk to each other rather than perform toward the viewer. Human gaze must target the phone; human and phone must form a conversational axis. Errol and Ninereeds phones must angle inward toward one another.
Reject correct identities if relation, salience, support, or anatomy fails. Do not repair or generate anything.
The rejected directory is provenance only and is not a candidate source.
